title: Cannabis Valentine's Day: Gifts, Date Night and Self-Care

body:
Cannabis Valentine's Day gifts land best when they fit the person: a low-dose edible for a curious partner, a pre-roll pack for a friend who knows what they like, or a good accessory for someone who seems to have everything. Plans matter as much as presents. This guide covers date-night pacing, gift ideas by product type, Galentine's and solo celebrations, and an easy infused chocolate-strawberry recipe with the dose math. Everything here is for adults 21 and older.

## How cannabis fits into Valentine's plans for couples, friends and solo celebrators

A candlelit dinner for two is only one way to spend Valentine's Day. Some people celebrate with a partner, some with friends, and some with a quiet night that is entirely their own. Cannabis can fit any of those plans, as long as a few basics hold:

- Everyone involved is 21 or older and chooses to partake; nobody should feel pressured.
- You know your own experience level and plan doses around it.
- You stay in, or line up a sober ride, so driving is off the table.

A short conversation beforehand about what everyone is comfortable with makes the whole night easier.

## Date-night ideas and pacing for two

A cannabis date night is mostly about timing.

- **Eat first, or with it.** An edible on an empty stomach can feel different from one taken after dinner.
- **Decide on doses together,** and start low if either of you is newer to cannabis.
- **Plan around the clock.** Edibles often take 30 to 90 minutes to start and peak around two to four hours after eating, while inhaled cannabis is felt within minutes. An edible with dinner at 7 may not arrive until dessert or later.
- **Skip alcohol.** Mixing the two makes it harder to judge how you feel.
- **Check in with each other.** A simple "How are you doing?" halfway through keeps the night comfortable.

### Cannabis and intimacy

Some couples include cannabis in intimate moments, but research on cannabis and sex is limited, and effects vary from person to person. Consent always comes first, and someone who is too impaired to decide clearly cannot give it. Our article on [marijuana and intimacy](/blog/marijuana-and-intimacy/) covers the topic in more depth.

## Gift ideas by product type and budget

Match the gift to the person's experience and preferences. The price ranges below are relative, since prices vary by product and store.

| Gift type | Good for | Price range | Tip |
|---|---|---|---|
| A single pre-roll or a small pack | Someone who already enjoys flower | Simple | Ask about the strain's aroma and THC level |
| Low-dose edibles | Curious or occasional consumers | Simple to mid | Look for modest milligrams per piece; our [cannabis chocolate guide](/blog/cannabis-chocolate-guide/) explains how to read them |
| Topicals | Someone who loves skin care or massage | Mid | Read the label for ingredients and directions; our [guide to cannabis topicals](/blog/guide-to-cannabis-topicals/) covers the types |
| Accessories | Anyone who partakes | Simple to splurge | Grinders, storage jars, rolling trays and lighters |
| A small bundle | A longtime enthusiast | Splurge | Pair one cannabis item with flowers or a handwritten note |

For more inspiration, see our guide to [gifts for cannabis lovers](/blog/gifts-for-cannabis-lovers/). Selection varies by store and changes often, so ask our budtenders at your [nearest High Society store](/dispensary-locations/) what is available.

## Activities: cooking together, infused mocktails, game night, massage with topicals

- **Cook together.** Make a non-infused dinner and let dessert be the only infused course, so the dose stays easy to track. The strawberry recipe below works well.
- **Infused mocktails.** Pour one serving of a THC beverage over ice with sparkling water and fruit, and keep a non-infused version on hand. In Michigan, a cannabis beverage can hold up to 10 mg of THC per serving and 100 mg per container.
- **Game night.** Card games, a puzzle or a two-player board game keep things playful.
- **Massage with topicals.** Try a small amount of a lotion or balm on your skin first, keep it away from eyes and broken skin, and follow the label.
- **Movie marathon.** Pick a stack of favorites, dim the lights and pace any edibles so you are still awake for the ending.

## Self-care and solo celebrations

A solo Valentine's Day can be the best kind. Plan a slow night on your own terms:

- Run a bath, put on a favorite playlist and pick up your favorite takeout.
- Journal, read or rewatch a comfort movie.
- If cannabis is part of the night, keep the dose modest and familiar, and set your phone aside.
- Give yourself something nice, like new pajamas, a candle or a book you have been meaning to read.

Spoiling yourself counts. Keep the plan simple: stay in, skip alcohol if you are using cannabis, and put products away afterward.

## Galentine's and anti-Valentine's get-togethers

Galentine's, the friends' celebration many people hold around February 13, and its cousin, the anti-Valentine's party, are great excuses to gather.

- **Galentine's brunch:** pastries, fruit and non-infused mocktails, with clearly labeled low-dose options for anyone who wants them.
- **Craft night:** make cards, paint or build bouquets while you catch up.
- **Anti-Valentine's movie night:** horror or action instead of romance, plus snacks everyone can share.
- **Host basics:** guests 21 and older only, everything infused labeled, plenty of non-infused food and drinks, and rides home sorted.

In Michigan you can share cannabis with other adults 21 and older at no charge, but you cannot sell it or charge guests for it.

## Easy infused chocolate-dipped strawberries with dose math

This recipe uses a labeled infused chocolate bar from a licensed store, so the starting potency is printed right on the package. Melting three 10 mg squares into plain chocolate gives 30 mg of THC for 12 strawberries, or about 2.5 mg per berry if every berry takes an equal share. Some chocolate always stays in the bowl, so each berry likely carries a little less.

- Make a second, plain batch for anyone who would rather skip THC, and mark the infused berries with a white chocolate drizzle so nobody mixes them up.
- Keep the heat low, since scorched chocolate turns grainy.
- Stir well before dipping so the infused chocolate spreads through the batch as evenly as possible.
- Bite-sized sweets are easy to mistake for ordinary dessert, so store them sealed and labeled. U.S. poison centers logged 3,054 cases of children under 6 eating cannabis edibles in 2021, up from 207 in 2017, and chocolate alone is harmful to pets.

The ingredient list, steps and dosing note are in the recipe card below.

## Gifting rules: 21+ only, and selection varies by store

- **21+ only.** Cannabis gifts are for adults 21 and older; giving cannabis to anyone under 21 is not allowed.
- **Gift, do not sell.** Michigan lets adults 21 and older give up to 2.5 ounces, with no more than 15 grams as concentrate, to another adult 21 or older, as long as nothing is received in return and the gift is not advertised or promoted.
- **Stay in Michigan.** Do not mail cannabis or carry it across state lines.
- **Check availability.** Products, flavors and formats vary by store and change often.
- **Keep the label.** Leave products in their original packaging, so the recipient can see the dose and warnings.

New to dosing yourself? Our [THC dosage guide](/blog/thc-dosage-guide/) walks through the basics. 21+ only. Please consume responsibly.

faq.q: What is a good cannabis gift for Valentine's Day?
faq.a: One that matches the person's experience. For a newcomer, a low-dose edible or a nice accessory is a thoughtful pick; for an experienced friend, a pre-roll pack or a favorite format they already enjoy. Add something non-cannabis, like flowers or a handwritten note, and only give cannabis to adults 21 and older.

faq.q: Can you gift cannabis to another adult in Michigan?
faq.a: Yes, within limits. Adults 21 and older may give up to 2.5 ounces, with no more than 15 grams as concentrate, to another adult 21 or older, as long as nothing is received in return and the gift is not advertised or promoted. Selling without a license is not allowed, and gifts to anyone under 21 are illegal.

faq.q: How do I dose infused chocolate strawberries?
faq.a: Divide the total THC by the number of berries. Melting 30 mg of THC, three 10 mg squares of a labeled infused bar, into the chocolate for 12 strawberries works out to about 2.5 mg each, as an estimate. Start with one berry and give it a full two hours before having more, since edibles can take 30 to 90 minutes to start.

faq.q: Is cannabis a good idea on a first date?
faq.a: Usually it is better to wait. On a first date you are still getting to know each other, and cannabis affects people differently, so a clear head makes it easier to read the room and stay safe. If you both use cannabis and want to include it, talk about it first, keep it low-dose, skip alcohol and do not drive.

faq.q: What are fun cannabis activities for couples?
faq.a: Cooking dinner together, a game night, a movie marathon, a shared playlist or a massage with a cannabis topical are all easy at home. Plan the timing, keep doses low and agree on the plan in advance. Staying in also keeps driving off the table, which is exactly where it belongs.

ingredients: 12 large strawberries, rinsed and dried completely
4 oz (113 g) plain semisweet or dark chocolate, chopped
3 squares (30 mg THC total) from a labeled infused chocolate bar with 10 mg per square, chopped
1 teaspoon coconut oil (optional, for a smoother coating)
1 oz (28 g) plain white chocolate, melted, to mark the infused berries
Flaky sea salt or crushed freeze-dried raspberries (optional topping)
steps: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Make sure the strawberries are completely dry so the chocolate clings.
Set a heatproof bowl over a pan of barely simmering water, without letting the bowl touch the water. Add the plain chocolate and coconut oil and stir until mostly melted.
Take the bowl off the heat, add the chopped infused chocolate and stir until smooth. Keep the heat gentle so the chocolate does not scorch.
Keep stirring for a full minute so the infused chocolate is spread evenly through the batch.
Hold each strawberry by its leaves and dip it to the same depth, so every berry carries a similar amount. Let the excess drip back into the bowl, then set it on the parchment.
Drizzle the white chocolate over the infused berries so they are easy to tell apart, add any topping and chill for about 20 minutes, until set.
Label the container as cannabis-infused, refrigerate and enjoy within a day. Store out of reach of children and pets.
recipe.dosingNote: **Dose math (an estimate):** 30 mg of THC divided by 12 berries is about 2.5 mg per berry, if each berry takes an equal share of chocolate. Some chocolate always stays in the bowl, so the real amount per berry is likely a little lower. A labeled infused bar puts the starting potency on the package; if you swap in homemade cannabutter or oil, THC per serving also depends on your starting material's potency and on decarboxylation and infusion losses, so the estimate gets rougher. Start with one berry, give it two full hours before having another, and skip alcohol. Label infused food clearly and keep it away from children and pets.

review.notes: Fact-check 2026-10-24: 23 claims checked; 1 non-ok (overstated) fixed, plus 1 safety clarification (one serving of a THC beverage). All 5 sources open and support their sentences: the benchbook and CRA bulletin are the law-facts sources for gifting and beverage caps, and Barrus 2016, Tweet 2023 and ASPCA were opened this pass. Cross-batch sweep 2026-10-24 (orchestrator, after the fact-check workflow): Michigan requires child-resistant packaging only for edible marihuana products (R 420.403(10); R 420.401(c) counts every infused product taken other than by inhalation, so drinks and tinctures too); R 420.501-508, including the R 420.504 label rule, set none for flower, vapes or concentrates (Cornell LII copies read 2026-10-24). Lines that said every product comes in child-resistant packaging now say original packaging.
